uncovered: Due while the rep is away
uncoveredMeans: the customer is expecting a call today or sooner and nobody is on this floor
stuckNothing: Nothing is stuck. Everything waiting is still inside its window.
waitingDays: {count, plural, one {# working day} other {# working days}}
overdueDays: {count, plural, one {# day overdue} other {# days overdue}}
addedDays: {count, plural, one {added # day ago} other {added # days ago}}
stuckRequestsMeans: {days, plural, one {more than # working day on the desk} other {more than # working days on the desk}}
stuckFollowUpsMeans: {days, plural, one {more than # day past its date} other {more than # days past its date}}
stuckNeverMeans: {days, plural, one {added more than # day ago} other {added more than # days ago}}
lastMonths: {count, plural, one {The latest month} other {The last # months}}
monthFirst: {month} is the first month with any metres in it
monthAfterEmpty: {month} had metres again after an empty {previous}
monthsMeans: Approved m² per month, against that month’s target.
chainMeans: {raised, plural, one {Of the one quotation raised in the last {days} days, this is where it got to.} other {Of the # raised in the last {days} days, this is where each one got to.}}
chainEmpty: Nothing has been raised in the last {days} days.
chainAnswered: {reached, plural, one {One of them reached a customer} other {# of them reached a customer}}{answered, plural, =0 {, and none came back with an answer.} one {, and one came back with an answer.} other {, and # came back with an answer.}}

chain.returned: Sent back, not asked again yet
chain.withCustomer: With the customer, no answer yet

chainReturnedOldest: {days, plural, =0 {the latest today} =1 {the oldest yesterday} other {the oldest # days ago}}
quietDays: {count, plural, one {no activity for # day} other {no activity for # days}}
openWithCustomer: {count, plural, =0 {none with a customer} one {# with the customer} other {# with the customer}}
openOnDesk: {count, plural, =0 {none on the coordinator’s desk} one {# on the coordinator’s desk} other {# on the coordinator’s desk}}
openReturned: {count, plural, =0 {none sent back} one {# sent back} other {# sent back}}
sentBackOrRefusedMeans: waiting on the rep, not on the customer
